Class StateMachine

java.lang.Object
machinery.StateMachine
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable, StateMachineInterface
Direct Known Subclasses:
PWSStateMachine
public class StateMachine extends Object implements StateMachineInterface, Cloneable
Mutable state machine with states, transitions, and current state.
